get.description:
Get a collection of `Mass Settlement` orders.
The result set can be restricted through filter parameter.
Only `Mass Settlement` orders will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
Paging is supported with parameters *limit* and *offset*.

post.summary: Create a new Mass Settlement order

201.description: Successfully created a new `Mass Settlement` order

get.description:
*Get a `Mass Settlement` order by ID*.
Only `Mass Settlement` order will be returned that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: doc_mass_settle_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Mass Settlement` order to get

patch.summary: Modify/update an existing Mass Settlement order
patch.description:
*Partially modify/update an existing `Mass Settlement` order identified by ID*.
Only `Mass Settlement` order will be replaced that can be accessed by the user (security applied).
If user does not have access to resource, not found error will be returned instead of unauthorized - to disallow attacks.

parameters.name: doc_mass_settle_id
parameters.description: ID of the `Mass Settlement` order to modify/update
